source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 3 同主题听力(选海洋夏令营/鲸类知识短文/参观科考船对话/海洋污染短文/规划潜水探险对话/世界海洋日短文)。长短交替(3长3短),用词限本单元/高中常见词,答案唯一且 transcript 可查证,与读写关不撞。

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Choosing a Sea Camp
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Have you decided which sea camp to join this summer, Tom?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I'm thinking about the whale watching camp. We'd help a real research team.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: That sounds exciting. What would you actually do there?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: We'd follow whales in a boat and take photos of their fins to tell them apart.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: I'd rather try the diving camp, where you learn to use underwater cameras.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Why diving? Isn't it a bit dangerous for beginners?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Maybe, but I really want to see coral reefs with my own eyes.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Fair enough. Let's each choose our own camp and share our stories afterwards.

exercises.translation_cn: Lucy 问 Tom 选了哪个海洋夏令营;Tom 想去观鲸营,能协助真正的研究团队,跟踪鲸并拍鳍照辨认;Lucy 更想去潜水营学用水下摄像机,因为想亲眼看珊瑚礁;两人决定各选各的,之后分享见闻。

questions.stem: Which camp is Tom thinking of joining?
What would Tom do at his camp?
options: Follow whales and photograph their fins.

questions.stem: Why does Lucy prefer the diving camp?
options: She wants to see coral reefs herself.
Her teacher chose it for her.

questions.stem: What is Tom's worry about diving?
options: It may be dangerous for beginners.

questions.stem: What do they finally decide to do?
options: Each choose a camp and share stories later.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 All About Whales
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Whales are among the largest and most intelligent creatures in the sea.
Scientists divide the main types of whales by the way they feed.
Whales use sounds both to talk to one another and to find their way.
Each whale has slightly different fins, which help researchers tell them apart.
By studying whales, we learn a great deal about the health of the ocean.
exercises.translation_cn: 鲸是海里最大、最聪明的生物之一;科学家按进食方式划分鲸的主要类型;鲸用声音彼此交流并辨别方向;每头鲸的鳍略有不同,帮助研究者辨认;通过研究鲸,我们能了解海洋的健康状况。

questions.stem: How are the main types of whales divided?
What do whales use sounds for?
options: To communicate and to find their way.

questions.stem: What helps researchers tell whales apart?
What does the passage say about whales' intelligence?
options: They are among the most foolish animals.
They are among the most intelligent sea creatures.
They are no smarter than fish.

questions.stem: Why is studying whales useful?
options: It helps us catch more of them.
It teaches us about the health of the ocean.

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 A Visit to the Research Ship
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Welcome aboard Kexue, one of China's most advanced research vessels.

transcript.speaker: Student
transcript.text: It's huge! People call it a moving laboratory on the sea, don't they?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: That's right. We can study samples within hours of bringing them up.

transcript.speaker: Student
transcript.text: How deep can your robots go?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Our vehicle Faxian can dive far below the surface to survey the sea floor.

transcript.speaker: Student
transcript.text: And it brings samples back to the ship?

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Yes, tons of geological samples that our scientists then examine here.

transcript.speaker: Student
transcript.text: No wonder Kexue is in a league of its own. Thank you for the tour!

exercises.translation_cn: 讲解员欢迎学生登上“科学号”科考船;学生说它被称作海上移动实验室;讲解员说采样后几小时内就能研究;深潜器“发现号”能下潜到海底进行勘测并带回大量地质样本供船上科学家研究;学生感叹科学号独领风骚并致谢。

questions.stem: What is Kexue often called?
options: A moving laboratory on the sea.

questions.stem: How soon can the team study the samples?
options: Within hours of bringing them up.

questions.stem: What does the vehicle Faxian do?
options: It dives deep to survey the sea floor.

questions.stem: What does Faxian bring back?
How does the student feel about Kexue at the end?
options: It is too small to matter.
It is just an ordinary boat.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 The Trouble with Plastic
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Plastic pollution has become one of the biggest dangers to our oceans.
Tiny pieces of plastic harm fish, birds and other marine creatures.
Shockingly, plastic has even been found in the tap water we drink.
Some experts say we should tax plastic bottles so that people use fewer.
Every small action, from using less plastic to cleaning a beach, can help.
exercises.translation_cn: 塑料污染已成为海洋最大的危险之一;细小的塑料碎片伤害鱼、鸟和其他海洋生物;令人震惊的是,塑料甚至已在我们喝的自来水中被发现;一些专家说应对塑料瓶征税,以便人们少用;从少用塑料到清理海滩,每个小行动都有帮助。

questions.stem: What is described as one of the biggest dangers to the oceans?
Where has plastic shockingly been found?
What do some experts suggest doing?
What harms fish, birds and other creatures?
What does the speaker say about small actions?

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Planning a Dive
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Captain
transcript.text: Tomorrow's dive will take us to a depth of about three hundred metres.

transcript.speaker: Diver
transcript.text: That's deep. Will we use the manned submersible?

transcript.speaker: Captain
transcript.text: Yes, but only two of us can go inside the small capsule.

transcript.speaker: Diver
transcript.text: What's our main task down there?

transcript.speaker: Captain
transcript.text: We'll film the coral and collect a few samples from the sea floor.

transcript.speaker: Diver
transcript.text: Should I worry about the cold and the pressure?

transcript.speaker: Captain
transcript.text: The capsule keeps us safe, but follow every step of the plan exactly.

transcript.speaker: Diver
transcript.text: Understood. I'll check all the cameras and lights tonight.

exercises.translation_cn: 船长说明天下潜约三百米深;潜水员问是否用载人潜水器;船长说会用,但小舱只能进两人;主要任务是拍珊瑚并从海底采几份样本;潜水员问要不要担心寒冷和压力;船长说舱内安全,但要严格按计划每一步执行;潜水员表示今晚检查所有摄像机和灯。

questions.stem: How deep will tomorrow's dive go?
How many people can go inside the capsule?
What is the main task during the dive?
options: To film coral and collect samples.

questions.stem: What does the captain tell the diver to do about safety?
options: Follow every step of the plan exactly.

questions.stem: What will the diver do tonight?
options: Check all the cameras and lights.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Why We Explore the Sea
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: People have explored less than five percent of the world's oceans.
Yet the sea covers most of our planet and shapes our climate.
Exploring it may lead to new medicines, food and sources of energy.
It can also help scientists predict events such as earthquakes.
The more we understand the sea, the better we can protect it.
exercises.translation_cn: 人类对世界海洋的探索还不到百分之五;然而海洋覆盖了地球大部分并影响着气候;探索海洋也许会带来新药、新食物和新能源;还能帮助科学家预测地震等事件;我们越了解海洋,就越能保护它。

questions.stem: How much of the oceans have people explored?
What does the sea do to our planet?
options: It covers most of it and shapes the climate.
It has no effect on us.

questions.stem: What might exploring the sea lead to?
What event can sea research help predict?
What is the main message of the passage?
options: We should never study the sea.
Exploration is a waste of time.
Understanding the sea helps us protect it.
